_comment: Live gateway config, derived from data/gateway_config.sample.json. Restructured to add an explicit models[] list per provider so the gateway never has to infer provider ownership from a model-name prefix. Provider names, model names, and alias names are preserved from the sample pack.

auto._comment: smart router: the gateway classifies each prompt's difficulty and routes to a tier; graded against data/routing_eval.jsonl

degradation._comment: Suggested thresholds for treating a provider as degraded and skipping to fallback.
